All four are ENVIRONMENTAL, proven by the exact difference: `apps/mobile/package-lock.json` at BASE_SHA locks `node_modules/qs` 6.16.0 and `@sentry/react-native` 8.24.0 (package.json:22), whereas the installed tree's `apps/mobile/node_modules/.package-lock.json` recorded `node_modules/qs` 6.15.3 and `apps/mobile/node_modules/@sentry` did not exist — i.e. the VM snapshot's node_modules predates BASE_SHA's lockfile and `npm ci` had not been re-run (Node 24 vs 22 was NOT the cause; the assertions are version/module-presence checks). After `npm ci` (exit 0) qs=6.16.0 and @sentry/react-native=8.24.0 are installed and all four suites pass. These tests are working as designed (they guard the locked dependency versions), so no code or test change is warranted; nothing was committed and the branch is pushed at BASE_SHA. INTERMITTENT ICNS TIMEOUT (RELEASE_READINESS §11, 'not yet explained'): the failing child is the first spawnSync in the suite that requires `./metro.config.js` (be-mobile-security-secrets.test.ts:842-849, 5 s deadline, 192 MB heap). Root cause UNKNOWN / not reproducible here (a 5 s hit needs ~25x degradation vs idle); per §11 no timeout relaxation, prewarming or reordering was applied.
